rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for entering an event or place, rather than for the fee itself.

example.english: You need to show a ticket for admission.
example.jyutping: jap6 coeng4 jiu3 ceot1 si6 mun4 piu3

rows.note: Use this specifically when admission means the money charged to enter or attend.

example.english: The admission is fifty dollars for this exhibition.
example.traditional: 呢個展覽嘅入場費係五十蚊。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zin2 laam5 ge3 jap6 coeng4 fai3 hai6 ng5 sap6 man1

rows.note: Use this when admission means acknowledging that a statement or argument is true or valid.

example.english: He finally made an admission that he was wrong.
example.traditional: 佢終於承認自己講錯咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 sing4 jing6 zi6 gei2 gong2 co3 zo2

rows.note: Use this for the act of accepting or admitting someone or something into a group or arrangement.

example.english: The club will offer admission to ten more new members this year.
example.traditional: 個會今年會接納多十個新會員。
example.jyutping: go3 wui2 gam1 nin4 wui5 zip3 naap6 do1 sap6 go3 san1 wui2 jyun4
